title: Zwischenbericht Quellen Into Bibliography
description: Remove the explicit Quellen tables from the mit-bestand Zwischenbericht (P.Q in anhang/projekte.tex and SB.Q in anhang/sekundaerbefunde.tex) and replace them with a proper biblatex bibliography: new references.bib, \cite in each project's Allgemein table and in the SB appendix intro, \SemioReferences rendered in the V Verzeichnisse appendix chapter. Also extend the shared semio-window.sty reference row to show the source URL and fix a suspected \citefield argument-order bug, verified against a rebuilt zukunftbau template.
